Between levels 8 and 40 this cave has tough creatures and the rewards aren't great. Get a team together and do all the quests in this cave at once (for example the {wiki:Dark Armor Quest}, which uses the same path).

1. Going down into the Edron Orc Cave

If you are not in **Edron**, take a boat: talk to the harbour captain in your city (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the Edron harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.

The cave is on an orc peninsula. To get there, go to the {wiki:Edron Flats}, the apartments just **south** of Edron castle, look for the {item:Sewer Grate} in the basement and follow the sewer until you come out on the surface on the other side. On the surface there are already {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen} and some {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}.
Never go without a {item:Shovel}: the entrance always has to be dug open and, without a shovel, you can't get back to Edron without the help of other players.

Go to the entrance of the {wiki:Edron Orc Cave}, **southwest** of Edron castle, and go down. You can also get there through a sewer in the Edron Flats basement. The entrance is hidden under a mountain (see the minimap); if it's covered, dig it open with the {item:Shovel}.

Here you only find {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen} and {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}. Follow the cave **west** and then **south**. There are a few side rooms, but there is basically only one path.

Go **west** and follow the passage **north**. Enter the **first room to the east** and go down the hole. You find {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen}, {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors} and maybe one or two {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers} lured by other players.
Path on the second floor to the hole
As soon as you go down the hole you are surrounded by {creature:Orc Shaman|Orc Shamans}. Use area runes to clear the room.
Energy attacks don't work on the shamans. The snakes they summon make aiming difficult and stop knights from reaching the shamans.

On this floor go **north**. You find more shamans and one or two {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}. You will pass through an area with a tiled floor: it's a sign you are on the right track. At the **north** end of that floor, go down another hole.
Path on the shaman floor to the hole

On this last floor there are {creature:Orc Shaman|Orc Shamans}, {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}, {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders} and lots of {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}. Go to the chest shown in the image and open it: it has a {item:Backpack} with 2 {item:Poison Dagger|Poison Daggers} and 30 {item:Poison Arrow|Poison Arrows}.
Location of the Poison Daggers chest
The {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders} and the Berserkers hit hard for low levels.
Going up to the first floor

Go back the same way: on each floor return to the spot where you fell and use the {item:Rope} to go up. On the shaman floor go back **south** along the tiled floor; on the second floor leave the room to the east, go back **south** through the passage and then **east** to the spot where you fell from the first floor.

On the first floor head **north** and **east** to the entrance and use the {item:Rope} again to come out on the surface. Then retrace the sewer path to the **Edron Flats** basement (with the {item:Shovel}, if the passage is covered). At the Edron port, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to other cities.
